title: Kwesten language - Wikipedia
text: Kwesten is a Papuan language of Indonesia. It is spoken in Arare, Holmhaven, Mafenter, and Omte villages in Sarmi Regency. [2]

title: Foja Range languages - Wikipedia
text: The Foja Range languages, or Tor-Kwerba in more limited scope, are a family of about two dozen Papuan languages. They are named after the Foja Mountains of western New Guinea.
